what_it_does: Introduces GoPIM, an optimization method for ReRAM-based Processing-in-Memory accelerators (specialized hardware that performs computation directly where data resides in memory rather than shuttling data back and forth) running Graph Convolutional Networks (neural networks operating on graph-structured data). Pipeline stages execute with widely varying durations and graph vertices have skewed degree distributions, causing crossbar resources to sit idle. GoPIM dynamically allocates memory crossbar (the computational grid) resources based on execution needs and distributes vertices evenly across crossbars.
